title: Normalized restriction/direct-image comparison is the canonical geometric mate
statement: Let Λ → Λ′ be a morphism of condensed commutative rings, f:X→Y any scheme morphism, and b:D_Y L_{Λ′,f} ≅ L_{Λ,f} D_X a scalar/pullback comparison, in the interfaces of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Assume PullNormalized: b is normalized by the universal computation counits and the ordinary conjugate balancing map. Then the hom of restrictPush(a,f,b), defined by uniqueness of composite right adjoints, equals scalarRestrictionPush(a,f), the geometric mate of the inverse canonical restriction/pullback comparison of [lem-sfb-internal-scalar-mate-projection]. No flatness of a is assumed.

proof.text: Reuse the proved generic ordinaryScalarUnit calculation from IntegralResiduePullOrdinaryUnit, now for arbitrary a. Apply it degreewise and descend to homotopy categories. It identifies the scalar-adjunction unit square for the ordinary pullIso and comapUpperStarIso.

Reuse the proved generic mixedDerivedUnitFac, exactLeftSquareFac and mateModel calculations from IntegralResiduePullFlatModelMateNormalized. They compute the scalar mate of scalarRestrictionPull inverse against the derived computation counits, with the ordinary identity of step 1 as input.

The functor D_Y followed by exact geometric pullback is a left derived functor of the ordinary composite: its pasted counit is an isomorphism on K-flat complexes. PullNormalized and cancellation of the ordinary pullIso identify the inverse of b with the scalar mate just computed, by the universal property of this left derived functor.

Apply Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv. Its iterated mate is scalarRestrictionPush by definition; its composite conjugate is restrictPush.hom. Expanding rightAdjointUniq transported along b proves the latter identification.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_scalar_restriction_push
    (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X)
    (hb : PullNormalized a f b) :
    (restrictPush a f b).hom = scalarRestrictionPush a f
